name: call_chain
description: Find all callers and callees of a function at a specific line. Use this when you need line-level precision (e.g., 'which function calls line 42?'). For file-level or symbol-level impact analysis, use impact_analysis instead. Also includes recently modified files (within 5 minutes) to highlight active development areas. REQUIRED: Call reindex first.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Call reindex first.

line.description: Line number of the function to analyze. Provide this OR symbol (at least one required).

symbol.description: Symbol name to analyze. Provide this OR line (at least one required). If both provided, symbol takes precedence.
